title: Asking for Something to Drink
label: ch:pt-coffee-tea-milk
canDo: I can ask for coffee, tea or milk in Portuguese, name each one's gender, and say which of the three actually descends from Latin.

payoff.summary: The chapter's last lesson closes the set with a one-table review of all three drinks' origins (Arabic/Turkish, Cantonese, Latin), then reaches back to Chapter 11's pao and agua/vinho and Chapter 5's trabalhar and Falo portugues to stock a full sentence: Trabalho no Porto e gosto de cafe.
